feeds.title: Clare Nash Architecture Green Blog
feeds.description: Clare Nash Architecture Ltd is based in Brackley in rural South Northamptonshire on the Oxfordshire border. Specialising in rural architectural design, particularly eco-refurbishment and new build, CNA design focus takes inspiration from the vernacular. Focusing on people, site, climate, location, context, sustainable and beautiful materials to produce buildings that sit well in their surroundings and suit the people who reside in them.
